newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Alpargatas says Newbridge to be major shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Alpargatas says Newbridge to be major shareholder.

text.p: Argentine textile and footwear firm Alpargatas said Monday investment fund Newbridge Latin America agreed to subscribe up to $80 million in the company's negotiable bonds.
Once the negotiable bonds are converted into ordinary shares Newbridge will become one of the main shareholders in Alpargatas, it said in a letter to the the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.
The company said the deal is one of the pillars of a financial plan aimed at strenghthening asset value.
It is also aimed at restructuring debt maturities through the issue of a mid-to-long term $150 million bond to be launched after the $80 million capital issue.
